MangaLens does not bundle these weights. An explicit download obtains the public pinned artifact
into private app storage; actual whole-file checksum, size, CPU graph and tensor contracts are
checked before a preview. Publisher metadata does not establish installed runtime compatibility
or image quality. The experimental output is transient and cannot modify saved images/text.
